ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels on the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white bilateral lobes with a central, downward-pointing dark chevron at the fluke base. Dense black speckling and mottling concentrated around the central dark patch and lower margins of both lobes. A localized brownish/tan pigment smudge is visible in the upper-mid region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 75 degrees; depth occupies approximately 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits low-frequency, high-amplitude irregular peaks, particularly toward the distal tip where pixel clusters suggest significant structural jaggedness.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convexity; the left lobe follows a relatively smooth, continuous arc, while the right lobe displays a more irregular, interrupted convex curve toward the distal terminus.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured white and grey circular clusters (barnacle scars/colonies) concentrated heavily on the far right distal tip and sparsely along the right lobe's upper trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, parallel vertical dark linear marks (rake marks) on the mid-right lobe; several faint, unaligned horizontal dark scratches visible on the lower-left white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss/buildup at the right distal tip; distinct parallel vertical rake marks on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized tan/yellowish-white pigmentation patch on the upper-left quadrant, distinct from the surrounding white background and dark mottling.
